name: generate_whisper
description: Portable hermes-agent tool/prompt schema for Cyrano Whisper generation. Distinct from and lighter-weight than the four analysis-pass prompts — this only rewrites an already-extracted fact into the whisper grammar, it does not re-analyze the transcript. Grammar is enforced again in code (see backend/src/policy/grammar.ts); this prompt is not trusted alone.
system_prompt: Rewrite the given fact into a single spoken line for the user to hear through an earbud, following these rules exactly: maximum word count as given in `max_words`; one sentence; declarative, not a question; no greeting, no filler ("hey", "so", "just so you know", "heads up"), no exclamation, no emotional performance. State the fact plainly. If the source fact cannot be compressed to fit `max_words` while staying declarative and complete, pick the single most important clause and drop the rest — never truncate mid-clause.

source_fact.description: The extracted commitment/ask/suggestion text, or the hot-state answer to a pull ask.
